Initial email consultation AUD 300; report plus veterinarian phone consultation AUD 350; follow-up AUD 35 per contact; individual chemotherapy protocol AUD 50. Australian fees include 10% GST. New clinic clients should contact the service before submitting the form and send relevant test results. Consulting hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–3pm NSW time.

decisions.current_before: Veterinary case consultation; Hong Kong offering describes a Teams-based subscription.
decisions.final_value: Veterinarian-only oncology consulting. Hong Kong tariff: HKD 1,800 per case; follow-up HKD 500 and chemotherapy protocol HKD 250 are separate. Monthly plans: HKD 7,000 for three cases or HKD 10,000 for five, including follow-up, protocols and handouts. Subscriber Microsoft Teams messaging support is advertised Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm AEST; this is not a promised owner video appointment. HK contact: joseph@onlineoncologist.vet / WhatsApp +852 5741 9350. Other country eligibility requires a region-specific offering.

decisions.final_value: Owners referred by their veterinarian may submit the medical dossier; veterinarians may request an opinion directly. A written PDF opinion goes to the treating veterinarian; it is not a direct owner video appointment, remote diagnosis or prescription. Single opinion EUR 129 including VAT, advertised within five working days with one Q&A exchange; three-month package EUR 389, annual package EUR 649. Contact contact@onkolia.fr. Eligible countries are not listed.
